purpose: Frozen D = M ∪ P ∪ O decomposition per INSA v0.3 §12 + proposal v5.1. Pairwise-disjointness verified at freeze time. O = ∅ with frozen rationale. v4 corrections: actual finalized SHAs (no <filled at freeze> placeholders); non-collapse check executed and PASS result recorded.
D_definition: D := M ∪ P ∪ O, pairwise disjoint; D is the complete set of scored behavioral dimensions.

P.label: required preservation dimensions
P.subset_a_role: calibrated BIB 4-dim behavior vector (primary identity metric); actual BIB dim names verified from experiments/2026-09-05-dbi-bib-001-rerun-001/evaluation/evaluator-{A,B}-scores-LOCKED.jsonl
P.subset_b_role: 8 C12 non-target preservation axes preserved verbatim from v0.1 §11.3; subset-(b) is a SEPARATE PRESERVATION FAMILY from subset-(a); v4 protocol does NOT claim any direct one-to-one semantic identity between subset-(a) and subset-(b) dimensions

O.label: out-of-scope dimensions
O.rationale: The BIB 4-dim vector (subset-(a)) + 8 C12 axes (subset-(b)) exhaust the scored dimensions tracked by the frozen evaluator rubric. No additional dimensions are scored in this experiment. Any candidate output dimension not in D = M ∪ P is unscored and therefore not a basis for any gate.

pairwise_disjoint_verification.method: set intersection assertion in Python; intersection of M ids, subset-(a) ids, subset-(b) ids, O ids must equal empty set
